Show the count and percentage in each category, including the denominator. Include a short literal excerpt illustrating a positive and a critical view if available, with source citations. Explain the main patterns and interpretation limits, and suggest two follow-up questions for the team. Base this analysis on comment text rather than numerical survey ratings, and do not identify respondents.
